title: Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network with Intuitionistic Fuzzy Estimates for Detection of Children Pneumonia
content: Pneumonia is one of the leading causes of morbidity and mortality in children, making its early detection critical for effective treatment. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for detecting childhood pneumonia using a hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) enhanced with intuitionistic fuzzy estimations (IFE). The hybrid model integrates the powerful feature extraction capabilities of CNN with the uncertainty handling and decision-making strengths of intuitionistic fuzzy logic. By incorporating IFE, the model is better equipped to handle ambiguity and noise in medical imaging data, resulting in more accurate and robust pneumonia detection. Experimental results on pediatric chest X-ray datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving higher sensitivity and specificity compared to traditional CNN approaches. This hybrid model offers a promising tool to assist healthcare professionals in early and accurate diagnosis of pneumonia in children.
